_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it won't be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option lets you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to end your randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here lets you set a recommended filler_traps percentage or even a default percentage

description: Include Super Battle mode progression and checks.
If a Super Battle goal is selected, this option is forced on to keep the goal reachable.
Include Time Challenge CPU items and Time Challenge checks.
If a Time Challenge goal is selected, this option is forced on to keep the goal reachable.
Increase the difficulty of the item pool to customize how challenging you want your playthrough to be.
When off, removes special-move items from the pool.
Choose how many Shadaloo Emblems are required for token goals.
Shadaloo Emblems are only added to the item pool when the selected goal requires them.
Controls how many Shadaloo Emblem items are placed compared to the required amount.
100 means only the required amount is placed. 200 means double the required amount is placed.
The final amount is capped at 100 Shadaloo Emblems.
